STEP 1 - Scene: plated lunch/dinner, grilled/fried chicken or fish pieces with mixed salad and tomatoes.

STEP 2 - Vessel: square white dinner plate ~26 cm side, ~24 cm effective diameter.
Area = 3.14 x (12)^2 = 452 cm^2

STEP 3 - Items: grilled chicken pieces (3), fried/breaded piece, lettuce leaves, tomato slices, red/yellow pepper strips, cucumber/yellow pepper bits, olive.

STEP 4 - Area:
- Chicken/meat pieces (3 large) = 26% = 118 cm^2
- Lettuce/leaves = 18% = 81 cm^2
- Tomato slices and cherry tomatoes = 9% = 41 cm^2
- Peppers = 4% = 18 cm^2
- Fried/yellow item (corn cake/potato) = 3% = 14 cm^2
- Olive = 0.5% = 2 cm^2
Total covered = 60.5% (≈ 273 cm^2)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Chicken pieces: 118 cm^2 x 2.0 cm = 236 ml
- Lettuce: 81 cm^2 x 3.0 cm = 243 ml
- Tomato: 41 cm^2 x 2.0 cm = 82 ml
- Peppers: 18 cm^2 x 1.0 cm = 18 ml
- Fried item: 14 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 21 ml
- Olive: 2 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 3 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Chicken: 236 ml x 0.95 = 224 g
- Lettuce: 243 ml x 0.15 = 36 g
- Tomato: 82 ml x 0.6 = 49 g
- Peppers: 18 ml x 0.6 = 11 g
- Fried item: 21 ml x 0.9 = 19 g
- Olive: 3 ml x 0.9 = 3 g
Total ≈ 342 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken: 224 g x 190 kcal/100g = 426 kcal
- Lettuce: 36 g x 15 = 5 kcal
- Tomato: 49 g x 18 = 9 kcal
- Peppers: 11 g x 25 = 3 kcal
- Fried item: 19 g x 250 = 48 kcal
- Olive: 3 g x 115 = 3 kcal
Total ≈ 494 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: 342 g with about 60% plate coverage and several meat pieces is plausible for a plated main with salad.
